title: Quantum Algorithm for Identifying Hidden Graphs: Spectral Theory and Numerical Evidence
summary: We give a quantum algorithm for a novel type of black-box problem: identifying a hidden $d$-regular base graph $G$ on $n$ vertices from oracle access to an obfuscated version of it, rather than traversing it. From $G$ we build the spired graph $G_{\rm spire}$ in three steps: each vertex is lifted into an exponentially large cluster, with adjacent clusters joined by a random bipartite graph; each cluster is then crowned with a balanced spire; finally, all vertices are randomly relabelled.
